title: The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes
author: Arthur Conan Doyle
desc: 名偵探福爾摩斯只看一眼衣服和鞋子，就能推理出你從哪裡來、做什麼工作。

intro: I'm reading 'The Adventures of Sherlock Holmes.' Holmes can learn everything about a person from their clothes!
我在讀《福爾摩斯冒險史》。福爾摩斯可以從一個人的衣服看出他的一切！

q: In one story, Holmes looks at a visitor's shiny sleeve and knows he writes a lot. What could someone learn from your clothes today?
有個故事中，福爾摩斯看到訪客發亮的袖子，就知道他常寫字。今天別人能從你的衣服看出什麼？
o: That I'm going to the gym.
我要去健身房。
gym = 健身房。
Sneakers and a sports bag. An easy case, Watson!
運動鞋和運動包。簡單的案子，華生！
That I have a cat. Look at all the fur!
我有養貓。看這些毛！
fur = 動物的毛。
Ha! Holmes would notice the cat fur in one second.
哈！福爾摩斯一秒就會注意到貓毛。
Probably that I was in a hurry.
大概是我很匆忙。
in a hurry = 匆忙。probably = 大概。
A button in the wrong hole? Holmes loves details like that.
扣子扣錯洞？福爾摩斯最愛那種細節。

q: Holmes notices mud on a woman's boots and knows which road she came by. Do your shoes tell a story?
福爾摩斯注意到一位女士靴子上的泥巴，就知道她走哪條路來。你的鞋子會說故事嗎？
o: Yes, they're worn out from walking.
會，它們因為常走路而磨損了。
worn out = 磨損、穿舊了。
A walker! Holmes would say you don't own a car.
愛走路的人！福爾摩斯會說你沒有車。
They're brand new, actually.
其實它們是全新的。
brand new = 全新的。actually = 其實。
Then Holmes would guess you just went shopping!
那福爾摩斯會猜你剛去購物！
They're always a bit muddy.
它們總是有點沾泥。
muddy = 沾泥的。a bit = 有點。
Country life? Or maybe a rainy city like London.
鄉村生活？還是像倫敦那樣的多雨城市。

q: Victorian gentlemen always wore a hat and gloves outside. Do you have a dress code at work or school?
維多利亞時代的紳士外出一定戴帽子和手套。你的工作或學校有服裝規定嗎？
o: Yes, I wear a uniform.
有，我穿制服。
uniform = 制服。
Uniforms make mornings easy. No need to choose!
制服讓早上變簡單。不用挑衣服！
Business casual, mostly.
大多是商務休閒。
business casual = 商務休閒穿著。mostly = 大多。
A nice shirt without a tie, right? Very modern.
好看的襯衫、不打領帶，對吧？很現代。
No rules. I wear whatever I want.
沒有規定。我想穿什麼就穿什麼。
whatever = 任何…的東西。
Freedom! Holmes would find you harder to read.
自由！福爾摩斯會覺得你比較難看透。

q: Holmes wears disguises: an old sailor, a priest, even a homeless man. If you needed a disguise, what would you wear?
福爾摩斯常喬裝：老水手、牧師，甚至流浪漢。如果你要喬裝，你會穿什麼？
o: Sunglasses and a big coat.
墨鏡和大外套。
sunglasses = 太陽眼鏡（複數）。
Classic spy style! Simple, but it works.
經典間諜風！簡單但有效。
A fake beard!
假鬍子！
fake = 假的。beard = 鬍子。
Ha! Holmes really uses fake beards and wigs in the stories.
哈！福爾摩斯在故事裡真的用過假鬍子和假髮。
A delivery uniform. No one notices delivery people.
外送員制服。沒人會注意外送員。
notice = 注意到。
Brilliant thinking! That's very Holmes.
聰明的想法！很有福爾摩斯的風格。

end: Elementary! Next time, let's visit his home on Baker Street.
很簡單！下次我們去貝克街拜訪他家。

intro: Now let's visit Holmes's famous home: 221B Baker Street!
現在來拜訪福爾摩斯有名的家：貝克街221B！

q: Holmes shares a flat with Dr. Watson. Would you like to have a roommate?
福爾摩斯和華生醫生合租一間公寓。你想要有室友嗎？
o: Yes, it saves money.
想，可以省錢。
save money = 省錢。
True! That's exactly why Watson moved in.
真的！這正是華生搬進來的原因。
No, I need my own space.
不要，我需要自己的空間。
own space = 私人空間。
Understandable. And Holmes plays the violin at 3 a.m.!
可以理解。而且福爾摩斯凌晨三點拉小提琴！
Only if they're tidy.
除非他們很整潔。
tidy = 整潔的。
Then Holmes is not for you. His room is a mess!
那福爾摩斯不適合你。他的房間一團亂！

q: Their landlady, Mrs. Hudson, brings them breakfast. What would you want your landlord to do for you?
他們的女房東哈德森太太會送早餐給他們。你希望房東幫你做什麼？
o: Fix things quickly when they break.
東西壞了趕快修。
fix = 修理。break = 壞掉。
That's the most important thing! A broken heater in winter is terrible.
那最重要！冬天暖氣壞掉很慘。
Just leave me alone.
別打擾我就好。
leave someone alone = 不打擾某人。
Ha! A quiet landlord is a good landlord.
哈！安靜的房東就是好房東。
Breakfast sounds perfect, actually.
其實送早餐聽起來很完美。
actually 放句尾 = 其實。
Right? Eggs and toast delivered to your door!
對吧？蛋和吐司送到你門口！

q: Holmes keeps his tobacco in a Persian slipper and pins his letters to the fireplace with a knife! Where do you keep important things?
福爾摩斯把菸草放在波斯拖鞋裡，還用刀把信釘在壁爐上！你把重要的東西放哪裡？
o: In a drawer by my bed.
床邊的抽屜。
drawer = 抽屜。by = 在旁邊。
Simple and safe. Much better than a knife!
簡單又安全。比刀子好多了！
Everywhere. I can never find anything.
到處都是。我從來都找不到東西。
never = 從不。
You and Holmes would get along, ha!
你和福爾摩斯會很合得來，哈！
In a folder on my desk.
書桌上的資料夾裡。
folder = 資料夾。
Very organized. Watson would be proud.
很有條理。華生會很驕傲。

q: Today, many fans visit the Sherlock Holmes Museum at 221B. Would you like to visit London?
今天很多粉絲造訪位於221B的福爾摩斯博物館。你想去倫敦嗎？
o: Yes! It's on my bucket list.
想！它在我的人生清單上。
bucket list = 人生願望清單。
Take the Tube to Baker Street station. The walls there have Holmes's face!
搭地鐵到貝克街站。那裡的牆上有福爾摩斯的臉！
I've already been there.
我已經去過了。
have been there = 去過那裡。
Lucky! London's double-decker buses are so fun.
好幸運！倫敦的雙層巴士好好玩。
Maybe, if it doesn't rain too much.
也許吧，如果雨不要下太多。
if = 如果。
Ha! Bring an umbrella. London loves rain.
哈！帶把傘。倫敦很愛下雨。

end: Thanks for the visit! The game is afoot... until next time.
謝謝你來訪！好戲開場了……下次見。
